items.title: 14.2 Hawa ke aalooda karne wale (air pollutants) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.2, printed pages 306-307.

blocks.title: Pollutants
blocks.text: Pollutants woh madde (gases, liquids aur solids) hain jo mahol ke liye nuqsan-deh hain. Air pollutants primary, seedhe paida ya kharij hone wale, jaise aatish-fishan ki raakh ya gari ke exhaust ki carbon monoxide, aur secondary, primary pollutants ke kimiyai reactions se banne wale, mein baante jate hain.

Sab se aham pollutants yeh hain: carbon ke oxides (CO aur CO2); nitrogen ke oxides (NO aur NO2, mil kar NOx); sulfur ke oxides (SO2 aur SO3, mil kar SOx); hydrocarbons (methane, ethane); kam oonchai ki ozone; chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs); polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs); persistent organic pollutants (POPs); volatile organic compounds (VOCs); particulate matter (PM); aur bhari dhatein (Pb, Hg aur Cd). Har ek 14.4 mein bayan hai.

blocks.caption: Primary aur secondary pollutants

ozone, PAN, acid rain ke acids, NO se NO2

blocks.prompt: Aham air pollutants batayein, aur kahein ke ozone aur sulfur dioxide mein se secondary pollutant kaun sa hai (Quick Check 14.1a; MCQ XI).
blocks.explanation: CO aur CO2, NOx, SOx, hydrocarbons, kam oonchai ki ozone, CFCs, PAHs, POPs, VOCs, particulate matter aur bhari dhatein lead, mercury aur cadmium. Sulfur dioxide primary hai, coal aur oil jalne se seedhi kharij; zameeni satah ki ozone secondary hai, dhoop mein NOx aur VOCs se hawa mein bani.

items: Pollutants mahol ko nuqsan dete hain; primary = seedhe kharij, secondary = primary pollutants se bane. Gyarah qismein: COx, NOx, SOx, hydrocarbons, kam oonchai ki O3, CFCs, PAHs, POPs, VOCs, PM, bhari dhatein.
